findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_server" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_server · Private data: lookup_server, search_servers, check_server, compare_servers, registry_summary · Public sink: compare_servers · Destructive: compare_servers, registry_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_server · Private data: lookup_server, search_servers, check_server, compare_servers, registry_summary · Public sink: compare_servers · Destructive: compare_servers, registry_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
